Potter Gulshan has used pit firing for 15 years, and every weekend she takes the pots she has made this way to a market to sell them.

In 2024, engineers found a problem with the 80-year-old stone bridge on the farm road, and trucks heavier than 5 tons were banned from it.

• The Ergashev family orchard has grown almonds for 40 years.
• Its manager, Rano Ergasheva, keeps 200 beehives among the trees.

• The glass wall let workers check the bees without opening the hive.

The Ergashev family orchard, which has grown almonds for 40 years, keeps 200 beehives among its trees.

Rano Ergasheva, the manager of the Ergashev family orchard, keeps 200 beehives among its almond trees.

why.ru: Слушатели знают сад, а цель — результаты. Их даёт только вариант о том, что мёда стало на 15% больше, и о последовавшем плане.

• Murod Haydarov runs a one-room farm museum in his village.

• It is open only on Sundays.
• Entry is free.
• Last year, 2,400 people visited.
• Most visitors came in school groups.

The student wants to emphasize how many people visit the museum while acknowledging its short opening hours.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

Although Murod Haydarov's one-room farm museum drew 2,400 visitors last year, it opens only on Sundays.
Murod Haydarov's one-room farm museum holds 300 old tools and charges nothing for entry.
Most of the 2,400 people who visited Murod Haydarov's museum last year came in school groups.

why.ru: Число посетителей — главная часть, а работа только по воскресеньям — часть с «although». Так построен только вариант с «Although it opens only on Sundays».

• A weather station team studied the first frost in 4 villages of one valley.
• Village A, at 900 meters, had its first frost on October 20.
• Village B, at 1,200 meters, had its first frost on October 9.
• Village C, at 1,500 meters, had its first frost on September 28.
• Village D, at 1,800 meters, had its first frost on September 15.
• The team was led by Komil Nazarov.

The student wants to make a general statement about how height and the first frost were related in the valley.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

Village D, at 1,800 meters, had its first frost on September 15, the earliest of the 4 villages.
Komil Nazarov's team recorded the date of the first frost in 4 villages of one valley.
Village A, at 900 meters, had its first frost on October 20, about 5 weeks after Village D.

why.ru: Общее утверждение охватывает все 4 деревни одним выводом. Это делает только вариант «the higher a village stood, the earlier its first frost came».

• On Lola Rahimova's sheep farm, 3 dogs guard the flock at night.
• The dogs are a mountain breed that grows to 60 kilograms.
• They live with the sheep from the age of 8 weeks.
• Growing up with the sheep makes the dogs treat the flock as their family.
• Before 2022, the farm lost about 10 sheep a year to wolves.
• Since the dogs arrived in 2022, no sheep has been lost to wolves.

The student wants to explain why the dogs live with the sheep from a young age and present the result for the farm.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

Lola Rahimova's 3 guard dogs belong to a mountain breed that can grow to 60 kilograms.
Since 2022, no sheep on Lola Rahimova's farm has been lost to wolves, compared with about 10 a year before.
Lola Rahimova's dogs live with the sheep from the age of 8 weeks so that they treat the flock as their family.

• Each new cabin holds 10 people.

Although the LED lamps weigh 3 kilograms instead of 9 and use a fifth of the power of the old ones, they cost twice as much to buy.

• The higher heat makes clay harder and less likely to chip.

Akmal fires his pots in an electric kiln at 1,000°C, while Sevara uses a wood kiln at 1,250°C.

• A snow fence is a line of wooden boards set up beside a road in winter.

• Before the fences, the pass closed for about 12 days each winter.
• Last winter, it closed for 2 days.

The student wants to explain what snow fences do to an audience unfamiliar with them and show that they work.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

Each November, Bekzod Turgunov's road crew puts up 3 kilometers of snow fence on the northern pass.

A snow fence, like the 3 kilometers that Bekzod Turgunov's crew puts up each November, is a line of wooden boards that slows the wind so that blowing snow drops behind it instead of on the road.

why.en: Two halves for a new audience: what a snow fence does and proof that it works. Only the choice ending "2 days last winter instead of about 12" gives both.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

Although Ibrohim Sobirov's greenhouse produces 900 kilograms of tomatoes between December and March, its stove burns 2 tons of wood each winter.
Winter tomatoes from Ibrohim Sobirov's greenhouse sell for 3 times the price of summer tomatoes.
Ibrohim Sobirov works alone in a greenhouse heated by a wood stove that burns 2 tons of wood each winter.

• Woodcarver Sherzod's class filled in 3 days.
• Potter Madina's class filled in 1 day.
• Metalworker Aziz's class filled in 4 days.
• Embroiderer Nozima's class filled in 2 days.
• Each class had 12 places.

The student wants to make a general statement about how much demand there was for the classes.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

Potter Madina's weekend class was the first of the five to fill, in just 1 day.
Metalworker Aziz's class took 4 days to fill, longer than any of the other classes.
The museum asked a weaver, a woodcarver, a potter, a metalworker and an embroiderer to teach.

why.en: A general statement covers all 5 classes. Only the choice saying every class filled its 12 places within 4 days does that; the others name one class or none.
why.uz: Umumiy fikr beshala mashgʻulotni qamrab oladi. Buni faqat har bir mashgʻulot 12 oʻrnini 4 kun ichida toʻldirgani haqidagi variant qiladi.
why.ru: Общее утверждение охватывает все 5 занятий. Это делает только вариант о том, что каждое заполнило 12 мест за 4 дня; другие говорят об одном или ни об одном.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.
